web_blocks.html: Zydus Lifesciences remains in a confirmed Stan Weinstein Stage 2 uptrend (+8.75% Stage 2 return, 75.5% RS percentile) [26]. Pharmaceuticals: Major holds 50.6% Stage 2 density (rank 10). The Nifty 50 sits in an Uptrend (narrow breadth) with 55.2% of stocks above their 50-DMA, 48.2% above their 200-DMA, 7 of 11 sectors in uptrends, and 3 distribution days. On the 2026-11-23 ledger bar, Zydus closed at ₹1,199.50. That was +2.86% above its 50-day SMA (₹1,166.18) and +2.34% above its 10-week EMA (₹1,172.04), with +3.67% 63-day RS and 4 distribution days. On the 2026-11-25 live TradingView session, shares rallied +3.04% on SEZ II/Ankleshwar EIR news to ₹1,236.00 (+4.30% above 10W EMA ₹1,185.02; +5.64% above 50D SMA ₹1,169.98) [26][29].

Price action displays a tight Volatility Contraction Pattern (STAGE2_VCP_VOLATILITY_SQUEEZE) [26]. Bollinger bandwidth compressed from 11.25% to just 6.28% as price coiled 2.42% below its ₹1,266.60 52-week high [26]. However, the +3.04% Nov 25 pop pushed 4-hour RSI to 70.38 (overbought intraday). Daily RSI(14) climbed to 63.95 and weekly RSI to 62.67 [26]. Meanwhile, 14-day ATR eased to ₹28.09 (2.27% of CMP), and Nov 25 volume was modest at 12.57 lakh shares (0.86x the 30-day average) [26]. Because Zydus sits +1.7% above our ₹1,167.24–₹1,215.29 buy zone two days before the Nov 27 PDUFA, we hold existing shares and refuse to chase ₹1,236.00. Zydus is absent from NSE F&O (NOT_OPTIONABLE_OR_ILLIQUID), restricting trades to cash equity.

web_blocks.html: Ownership structure reinforces the tight VCP float. Promoters hold an immovable 75.01%—at India's statutory cap—leaving a narrow ~25% public float [19]. Within that float, FIIs added +16 bps in September 2026 to 7.05% while DIIs edged up to 11.28% [19]. Retail ownership dropped to 6.66% as shareholder count fell from 4,18,314 in March 2026 to ~3,82,000 in September 2026 [19]. Weak hands exiting into institutional absorption explains why Bollinger bandwidth compressed to 6.28% ahead of the Nov 27 FDA date [17][26].

Upward-Only Stop-Loss Ratchet & Multi-Timeframe Confluence: Because Zydus is now held in Zerodha (115 shares, ₹1,189.07 avg cost), we enforce our upward-only stop-loss ratchet. Our prior structural stop sat at ₹1,101.52. With the 30-week SMA rising from ₹1,117.16 to ₹1,128.49 and the 10-week EMA climbing from ₹1,174.46 to ₹1,185.02, we ratchet our closing stop-loss upward to ₹1,114.44 (+1.17% higher, sitting below both Pivot S1 ₹1,143.03 and the 30-week SMA) [26]. On the 4-hour chart, the 50-SMA (₹1,189.10) aligns within ₹4.08 of the weekly 10-EMA (₹1,185.02), anchoring the heart of our ₹1,167.24–₹1,215.29 buy zone [26].

Cash-Only Risk Math & Overnight Gap Disclosure: Lacking NSE F&O liquidity (NOT_OPTIONABLE_OR_ILLIQUID) keeps intraday noise low (2.27% ATR) but removes listed put hedges ahead of the Nov 27 PDUFA [26]. On our 115-share starter (3.24% NAV; ₹1,36,742.90 cost basis), the ratcheted ₹1,114.44 GTT stop caps non-gap downside at -6.28% below avg cost (~₹8,582, or 0.20% of ₹42.60 lakh NAV). However, an overnight USFDA CRL gap-down to ₹973–₹1,050 would bypass the GTT stop and realize ~0.38%–0.58% of NAV (~₹16,000–₹25,000). That unhedged binary gap risk is why we cap pre-PDUFA exposure at 3.24% NAV. Meanwhile, the Nifty 50 remains in an Uptrend (narrow breadth) with 55.2% of stocks above their 50-DMA and 3 distribution days, supporting a post-PDUFA breakout above ₹1,266.60 on ≥1.5x volume (~22 lakh shares) [26].

book_subsections.title: The Anatomy of a Razor-Tight Volatility Squeeze
paragraphs: Since our mid-November underwriting, Zydus Lifesciences has coiled even tighter. On November 23, the ledger close sat at eleven hundred ninety-nine rupees and fifty paise, with sixty-three-day relative strength turning positive at plus three point seven percent. Two days later, on November 25, news of USFDA Establishment Inspection Reports for SEZ II Ahmedabad and Ankleshwar API Unit-2 sparked a three percent rally to twelve hundred thirty-six rupees—just two point four percent below the fifty-two-week high of twelve hundred sixty-six rupees and sixty paise.

Beneath that pop, Bollinger bandwidth has compressed to just six point two eight percent, and fourteen-day average true range has narrowed to twenty-eight rupees, or two point three percent of price. In Mark Minervini's framework, a six-percent volatility squeeze inside a Stage 2 uptrend is a loaded spring. Yet chasing a four-hour RSI of seventy point four just forty-eight hours before a binary FDA decision is poor risk management. Because Zydus is not traded in NSE futures and options, cash-equity entry discipline and stop placement do all the heavy lifting.

book_subsections.title: Ratcheting the Stop Upward to Protect Our Starter Position
paragraphs: Between November 16 and November 23, our Zerodha account initiated a starter position of one hundred fifteen shares at an average cost of eleven hundred eighty-nine rupees and seven paise—roughly three point two four percent of portfolio net worth. Now that the stock is held and its rising moving averages have climbed higher, we enforce our upward-only stop-loss ratchet.

With the thirty-week simple moving average rising to eleven hundred twenty-eight rupees and forty-nine paise and Pivot S1 holding at eleven hundred forty-three rupees, we raise our closing invalidation stop from eleven hundred one rupees and fifty-two paise to eleven hundred fourteen rupees and forty-four paise. That single adjustment locks in a maximum downside of roughly six point three percent below our average cost—less than zero point two zero percent of total portfolio net worth—while giving the stock room to breathe through November 27 volatility.

callouts.title: Why Stops Only Move One Direction
callouts.text: Once a Stage 2 position is live and its weekly moving averages rise, your invalidation stop must ratchet upward—never downward. Raising the floor from ₹1,101.52 to ₹1,114.44 tightens portfolio risk ahead of a binary FDA date.

book_subsections.title: Follow the Float: Institutional Absorption Behind the Squeeze
paragraphs: September 2026 shareholding data explains why supply dried up so completely. Promoters hold seventy-five point zero one percent at the statutory ceiling. In the remaining twenty-five percent public float, foreign institutions added sixteen basis points to seven point zero five percent, and domestic institutions edged up to eleven point two eight percent, while thirty-six thousand retail accounts exited between March and September 2026.

When weak retail hands exit into institutional absorption right atop a rising ten-week exponential moving average of eleven hundred eighty-five rupees and a four-hour fifty-period average of eleven hundred eighty-nine rupees, upside breaks can travel fast. Still, volume on November 25 was only zero point eight six times the thirty-day average; true institutional breakout confirmation requires a post-PDUFA close above twelve hundred sixty-six rupees and sixty paise on at least one point five times average volume.

book_subsections.title: Confluence on the Four-Hour and Weekly Charts
paragraphs: One of the clearest structural signals in Zydus's chart is how tightly short-term and medium-term institutional support align. On the weekly chart, the ten-week exponential moving average has climbed to eleven hundred eighty-five rupees and two paise. On the four-hour intraday chart, the fifty-period simple moving average sits at eleven hundred eighty-nine rupees and ten paise—just four rupees away and virtually identical to our eleven hundred eighty-nine rupee seven paise Zerodha average cost.

When swing support and institutional trend support converge inside the heart of an eleven hundred sixty-seven to twelve hundred fifteen rupee buy zone, buyers typically defend that shelf aggressively on post-event pullbacks. Meanwhile, daily trading volume on November 25 was only zero point eight six times the thirty-day average, showing that institutions have not yet committed full breakout size ahead of November 27. Waiting for volume of at least one point five times average—roughly twenty-two lakh shares—on any breakout above twelve hundred sixty-six rupees ensures we add Tranche Two only when real institutional demand confirms.

book_subsections.title: Understanding Overnight Gap Risk Without an Options Hedge
paragraphs: Every technical trader learns the difference between ordinary daily volatility and overnight binary event gaps. In normal trading sessions, Zydus Lifesciences is remarkably well-behaved, with a fourteen-day average true range of twenty-eight rupees—just two point three percent of price—and clean respect for its ten-week exponential and thirty-week simple moving averages. On our one hundred fifteen-share starter position at an average cost of eleven hundred eighty-nine rupees and seven paise, ratcheting our Zerodha GTT closing stop upward to eleven hundred fourteen rupees and forty-four paise caps ordinary non-gap downside at six point three percent below cost, or roughly eight thousand five hundred eighty rupees—just zero point two zero percent of our forty-two point six zero lakh rupee portfolio.

However, an honest risk manager never pretends a stop-loss order can stop an overnight FDA gap. Because Zydus Lifesciences is not included in the NSE futures and options segment, there is no liquid put option available to insure the position forty-eight hours before the November 27 saroglitazar PDUFA decision. If the USFDA were to issue an unexpected Complete Response Letter after market hours, the stock could open directly inside our nine hundred seventy-three to one thousand fifty rupee bear stress band, bypassing the eleven hundred fourteen rupee GTT trigger entirely. On one hundred fifteen shares, that overnight gap would realize roughly sixteen thousand to twenty-five thousand rupees—or zero point three eight to zero point five eight percent of total portfolio net worth. That exact gap-risk calculation is why we refuse to chase Tranche Two at twelve hundred thirty-six rupees today and cap our pre-PDUFA exposure strictly at three point two four percent of net worth.

book_subsections.title: Market Regime and Execution Checklist
paragraphs: As of November 23, 2026, the Nifty 50 sits in an uptrend with narrow breadth—fifty-five percent of stocks above their fifty-day average, forty-eight percent above their two-hundred-day average, seven of eleven sectors in uptrends, and only three distribution days in twenty-five sessions. Pharmaceuticals: Major holds fifty point six percent Stage 2 density, ranking tenth across sectors.

Before touching any order, verify three rules: hold our one hundred fifteen shares with a ratcheted GTT stop at eleven hundred fourteen rupees and forty-four paise; refuse to chase new capital at twelve hundred thirty-six rupees ahead of the November 27 PDUFA; and deploy Tranche Two only after PDUFA de-risking on either a high-volume breakout above twelve hundred sixty-six rupees and sixty paise or a controlled retest of eleven hundred sixty-seven to twelve hundred fifteen rupees.
